data.title: Home contents insurance (Hausratversicherung) policy confirmation
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG issued a policy document (Versicherungsschein) for a home contents insurance ("Hausratversicherung Komfort") for Mara Beispiel, starting 1 October 2026 with a sum insured of €65,000.00 and an annual premium of €96.60.
data.explanation: This is your insurance policy confirmation for home contents insurance starting on 1 October 2026, running for one year and renewing automatically each year unless cancelled in writing (Textform) at least three months before the end of that insurance year — the app will show the cancellation window before each renewal. The first premium of €96.60 will be collected automatically by direct debit (Lastschrift) at the start of the policy, and then once per year going forward. No action is needed now, but check that the sum insured (€65,000.00) still matches the value of your belongings, and keep the policy number for any future claims or correspondence.
